class.name: CgameMocapCleanup
class.description: [CgameMocapCleanup] collects stateless functions for cleaning captured animation tracks: One Euro filtering, zero-phase Butterworth low-pass, rotation smoothing in log space, spike removal, Hermite gap filling, foot contact detection and foot-skate removal, root motion extraction, key reduction and retiming. Position tracks are [PackedVector3Array]; rotation tracks are arrays of [Quaternion].

method.name: butterworth
method.description: Zero-phase second order Butterworth low-pass (forward and backward pass with edge padding).

method.name: detect_contacts
method.description: Flags frames where the foot is within [param height_threshold] of its lowest point and slower than [param speed_threshold]. Runs shorter than three frames are dropped.

method.name: extract_root_motion
method.description: Splits a hips track into a ground [code]root_positions[/code], unwrapped [code]root_yaw[/code] following the travel direction, and [code]hips_local[/code] in the root frame.

method.name: fill_gaps
method.description: Replaces invalid frames with Hermite interpolation between valid neighbors (held values at the ends).

method.name: fill_gaps_rotations
method.description: Replaces invalid rotations with spherical interpolation between valid neighbors.

method.name: fix_foot_skate
method.description: Pins the foot at its mean position during each contact run and blends the offset into the surrounding frames.

method.name: make_continuous
method.description: Normalizes rotations and flips signs so consecutive quaternions are on the same hemisphere.

method.name: one_euro_positions
method.description: One Euro filter: low jitter at low speed, low lag at high speed ([param beta] controls the speed coefficient).

method.name: reduce_keys
method.description: Ramer-Douglas-Peucker key reduction. Returns the indices of the frames to keep.

method.name: remove_spikes
method.description: Detects outliers against a running median (robust sigma) and repairs them with [method fill_gaps].

method.name: retime
method.description: Resamples a track to another frame rate using cubic interpolation.

method.name: retime_rotations
method.description: Resamples a rotation track to another frame rate using spherical interpolation.

method.name: smooth_rotations
method.description: Low-pass filters a rotation track in the tangent space around the first rotation.
